organization: Conciliation Resources, with Transcend Oceania and the Pacific Centre for Peacebuilding

title: Perspectives on climate change and adaptation in Fijian villages contemplating relocation
organization: Frontiers in Climate; Yuki Yoshida, Giles B. Sioen, Gauna Metuisela and Richard Crichton
geographic_coverage: Vanua Levu: Macuata and Cakaudrove provinces
temporal_coverage: Qualitative village field visits in March 2024; published 4 September 2025.
methodology: March 2024 qualitative field visits, interviews and talanoa across seven purposively selected iTaukei villages.
limitations: Brief scoping sample centered on village leaders; not representative or causal; field notes summarize local accounts.

title: Climate Change and Sea Level Rise, Fiji
geographic_coverage: Votua, Nawaqarua and Etatoko villages, lower Ba River Catchment, Viti Levu
temporal_coverage: IMF paper completed 30 May 2025 and published June 2025; includes modeled sea-level-rise scenarios and earlier relocation cases.
methodology: IMF staff estimates sea-level-rise costs and adaptation with CIAM; Box 1 summarizes prior village relocation research.
limitations: Local cases are explicitly partial and anecdotal; CIAM requires finer topographic, population and asset data.

title: Climate change and the planned relocation of people: A longitudinal analysis of Vunidogoloa, Fiji
organization: Ambio; Celia McMichael, Teresia Powell, Annah E. Piggott-McKellar and Merewalesi Yee
temporal_coverage: Seven qualitative research waves in Vunidogoloa from 2015 to 2023; journal issue June 2025.
methodology: Longitudinal qualitative study with 41 interviews and 11 talanoa discussions over seven visits from 2015–2023.
limitations: Online publication 8 January 2025, June issue. Qualitative longitudinal village study, not causal attribution or a current national assessment.
